newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Puleva-Uniasa free capital issue from July 7.
newsitem.headline: Spain Puleva-Uniasa free capital issue from July 7.

text.p: Puleva-Uniasa's free capital increase will take place from July 7 to August 7, a spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday.
Uniasa said in April that shareholders would receive one new share for every five old shares. The new shares will have the same rights as the old ones as of January 1 1997.
The firm has also said it would continue the same policy in the following two years, 1998 and 1999.
The second issue will give shareholders one new share for four old, while the third issue will give one new share for every three old.
